purpose: silver_nyc_weather provides cleaned, typed hourly weather observations for NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) during 2013, feeding downstream flight-delay and weather-correlation analytics.
usage: Consumers should treat (origin, time_hour) as the unique grain for joins, read temp/dewp/humid/pressure/precip/visib as decimal measurements, and explicitly handle nulls in wind_dir, wind_speed, wind_gust, and pressure rather than assuming zero or imputing a value.
limitations: wind_gust is null in 74.6% of rows (9702 of 13014) and pressure is null in 11.5% of rows (1496 of 13014); these gaps were not imputed and must be handled by consumers. The landed batch carries only a single distinct year value (2013), so no cross-year comparison is possible from this table alone.
